company.shortDescription: Kuna is a smart Wi-Fi camera and intercom built into an outdoor light. It detects people at your door and lets you see and talk to them.
company.description: Kuna is a smart Wi-Fi camera and intercom built into an outdoor light fixture. It detects people at your door and lets you see and interact with them through your smartphone. Kuna’s security system proactively alerts homeowners of possible intruders, rather than reacting to a break-in attempt and reporting it afterward. With no batteries required and simple installation in less than 15 minutes, Kuna is your digital doorman to keep your home safe.
